params.message:
Home hero: keep Sanity line breaks, shade to AAA

Multi-line Sanity texts (hero, story, sell intro, history intro) keep their paragraphs and
bullet lists instead of running into one block. The hero intro is white and the shade is
70% brand-900, the lightest at which all hero text reaches AAA on the staging and built-in
photo; from lg on it covers the text column only.
